description: If the finite set \(S\) contains every atom in \(\Gamma\), eliminating all atoms of \(S\) produces the empty clause exactly when \(\Gamma\) is unsatisfiable; if the empty clause is absent, there is a valuation satisfying \(\Gamma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.eliminate_all_decides.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.ClauseSet α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Supported S Γ) :
  (∅ ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.eliminateMany S.toList Γ ↔
      ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Sat Γ) ∧
    (∅ ∉ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.eliminateMany S.toList Γ →
      ∃ v, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Resolution.Models v Γ)
